channel.title: NanoClip Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.7.9
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.9

  • Quick Copy now confirms copied text with a brief menu-bar icon change. You can also choose an animation beside the selected text or turn feedback off.
  • Quick Copy now ignores window moves, resizing, and control drags.
  • Restored the glass appearance of the shortcut bar in the Liquid Glass theme.
  • View your license activation count and reset old installations from License settings.
  • Improved license recovery and clearer activation error messages.

item.title: Version 1.7.7
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.7

  • Quick Copy automatically copies text when you finish selecting it. Enable it in Settings → General; this update improves activation and compatibility across apps.
  • NanoClip now stays in the same position when reopened, with your side preview visible immediately if you keep it open.
  • Escape reliably closes the clipboard window, including when a preview has focus.

item.title: Version 1.7.6
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.6

  • Added optional Quick Copy: select text and release the mouse to copy it automatically.
  • Fixed search and category filters missing older clipboard items until you scrolled through history.
  • Fixed the clipped banner when choosing clipboard input for a Flow.
  • The clipboard window now expands and contracts when you open or close the detail pane.
  • Slightly increased the menu bar icon size.

item.title: Version 1.7.5
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.5

  • Keep pinned clips out of All by default, with a setting to restore the previous behavior.
  • Double-click clips, snippets, or flows to use them just like pressing Return.
  • Press ⌘← in Flows to return to Clipboard.
  • Exclude individual files or entire folders from clipboard history.
  • Wrap Flow text with a custom prefix and suffix—for example,
    and
    .

item.title: Version 1.7.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.4

  • Added native Quick Look previews for image clips — select an image and press Space.
  • Clipboard and snippet cells can now be selected with the mouse, without pasting or closing NanoClip.
  • Refined the glass command bar so content flows naturally beneath it while the final list and preview content remains reachable.
  • Improved Universal Clipboard capture reliability for delayed remote clipboard transfers.
  • Improved Flows with mouse selection, visual drag-and-drop step reordering, and easier step insertion.

item.title: Version 1.7.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.3

  • NanoClip for iOS is now available to download for free.
  • Improved VoiceOver navigation across Clips, Flows, and Snippets.
  • Fixed previews for whitespace-only clipboard content.

item.title: Version 1.7.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.2

  • This update improves search reliability, picker behavior, and settings persistence.
  • Search now scans your complete clipboard history, including full URLs and file paths.
  • The picker now opens on the display you’re currently using.
  • Plain numbers are no longer incorrectly identified as phone numbers.
  • Ignored and obfuscated app settings now save and load reliably.
  • Search mode now hides the tab selector for a cleaner layout.
  • Refined the picker footer with a lighter, native glass appearance.

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.1

  • Improved performance

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.0

  • Copy Stack lets you merge multiple text clips with ⌘C and paste them together with Return.
  • Choose whether Copy Stack items are separated by a space, new line, or nothing.
  • Optionally show the live Copy Stack result at the top of Clipboard History.
  • Press ⌘⇧Delete to clear your entire clipboard history after confirmation.
  • Press ⌘W to close NanoClip.
  • Search fields now support native macOS selection shortcuts such as ⌘A and ⌘⇧Arrow.
  • Deleting an item keeps the side preview open and focuses the next item.
  • Text edited with ⌘E now updates immediately.
  • Fixed Ignored Apps sometimes disappearing after navigating elsewhere in Settings.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.6.1

  • Added a searchable emoji picker with categories, recent emoji, favorites, skin-tone variants, and a Control-Command-E shortcut.
  • The picker can now be freely moved and resized, snaps to useful screen positions, and remembers its size and location.
  • Added horizontal tag filters to Snippets while preserving full keyboard navigation.
  • Added an option to keep the side-panel preview open and fixed picker settings not persisting after quitting.
  • Refined Liquid Glass and theme backgrounds with native materials and optional tinted vibrancy.
  • Improved first-sync reliability with the NanoClip iOS companion.
  • Global shortcuts now follow the active keyboard layout, including Turkish F Extended.
  • Fixed empty-category layouts, unsupported emoji rendering, skin-tone sequences, and several picker resizing issues.
  • Added user information about what’s new.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.6.0

  • Added a searchable emoji picker with categories, recent emoji, favorites, skin-tone variants, and a Control-Command-E shortcut.
  • The picker can now be freely moved and resized, snaps to useful screen positions, and remembers its size and location.
  • Added horizontal tag filters to Snippets while preserving full keyboard navigation.
  • Added an option to keep the side-panel preview open and fixed picker settings not persisting after quitting.
  • Refined Liquid Glass and theme backgrounds with native materials and optional tinted vibrancy.
  • Improved first-sync reliability with the NanoClip iOS companion.
  • Global shortcuts now follow the active keyboard layout, including Turkish F Extended.
  • Fixed empty-category layouts, unsupported emoji rendering, skin-tone sequences, and several picker resizing issues.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.5.0

  • iOS beta sync: NanoClip 1.5 is required for the iOS companion to sync. Remember to enable iCloud Sync in Settings on your Mac.
  • Added a Settings link to join the NanoClip iOS TestFlight beta.
  • Added custom date-format snippet presets, including formats such as {date format="yyyyMMdd"}.
  • Added typed snippet arguments, including number-aware input and remembered recent values.
  • Made Strip Formatting safe for plain text while continuing to convert rich text.
  • Improved Mac clipboard image presentation with square thumbnails and cleaner side-panel rendering.
  • Fixed Flow Results windows appearing without a background on Liquid Glass themes.
  • Fixed long-list performance and side-panel clipping.
  • Fixed Mac license credentials sometimes needing to be entered again after an update or temporary network failure.
  • Fixed placeholder diagnostics and unresolved tokens appearing in pasted output.
  • Rebuilt clipboard and snippet sync around per-item CloudKit records for more reliable merging and pinned-first ordering.

item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.4.3

  • Minor bugfixes

item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.4.2

  • Fixed clipboard copies being silently dropped when copying quickly from Excel and other Office apps.
  • Fixed newly copied items sometimes appearing further down the list instead of at the top.
  • Fixed clipboard items occasionally flickering in and out of the list while iCloud sync was on.
  • Fixed Pro licenses being reset to free after an app update.
  • Quick actions now only appear when they're actually useful for what you copied (no more suggestions on passwords, tokens, or IDs).
  • Added a setting to hide quick actions entirely (Settings → Picker).

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.4.1

  • Fix bug updating pinned items

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.4.0

  • NanoClip now includes contextual Quick Actions in the picker for text, links, colors, JSON, and images.
  • Quick Actions can be run instantly from the keyboard with Option+number shortcuts.
  • Image Quick Actions include OCR, Compress, Resize, Convert to PNG, and Describe.
  • AI Quick Actions now appear when relevant and clearly show when Apple Intelligence or NanoClip Pro AI is required.
  • Quick Action results now open in a redesigned results panel with cleaner layout and better output readability.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.3.0

  • Added Smart Clip Categories in the Clipboard picker: All, Pinned, Links, Images, Files, Colors, Code, Secrets, and AI.
  • Added keyboard category cycling with ⌘[ / ⌘].
  • Cleaned up the bottom picker bar so it focuses on current-item actions.
  • Fixed Preview Style persistence so Side panel stays selected after quitting and reopening NanoClip.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.2.0

  • New AI image flows are here: You can now use NanoClip flows to generate images from text prompts, edit images you copied with a prompt, upscale images, and describe images as text. Image results can be copied or pasted back into other apps just like the rest of your clipboard workflow.
  • This update also adds image model settings for supported providers, so you can choose which provider and model NanoClip uses for generation, editing, upscaling, and image description.

item.title: Version 1.1.8
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.8

  • Fixes memory issues and slow response that appear when Nanoclip is left open for long time

item.title: Version 1.1.7
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.7

  • Fixed major picker performance regressions that made scrolling feel janky, especially in long lists.
  • Reduced expensive per-row work in clipboard history by improving caching.
  • Fixed Snippets keyboard navigation when snippets are grouped by tag. Up/down selection now follows the same order shown visually.
  • Fixed Flows preview behavior so the “Side Panel” preview setting is respected.

item.title: Version 1.1.6
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.6

  • NanoClip's picker window now appears immediately when you invoke it.
  • Added a Picker setting to turn open and close animations on or off.

item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.5

  • Added support for importing Rocket Typist snippets

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.4

  • Removed the unclear Clean Text starter flow.
  • Added Clean URL to remove common tracking parameters from links.
  • Added URL to QR Code to generate a QR image from a copied URL.
  • Kept Fix Spelling as its own separate flow.
  • Added flow descriptions so users can understand what each flow does.
  • Added expandable flow rows showing the description and each step.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.3

  • This release adds better organization for snippets and makes Flows more useful for real-world file workflows.
  • Snippets can now be tagged with #tags.
  • The Snippets view can group items by tag, enabled by default when tagged snippets exist.
  • Snippets without tags stay unsectioned until you start using tags.
  • Flows can now run on multiple compatible items at once.
  • Use Cmd + Return while choosing flow input to select multiple clipboard items, then Return to run the flow.
  • File-based flows can now receive multiple selected files, making workflows like compressing several images much faster.
  • Flow results now make image/file outputs clearer, including better previews and clipboard behavior for batch outputs.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.2

  • This update polishes the new Flows release and fixes a few rough edges from 1.1.1.
  • Added Flow usage stats in the Stats tab, including total runs, runs today, success rate, and top-used flows.
  • Added an Open Flows Guide button in Flow settings.
  • Added a Feature Request menu item that opens the NanoApps feedback board.
  • Improved snippet expansion reliability by tightening Input Monitoring registration.
  • Improved selected row icon contrast for snippets and flows across themes.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.1

  • Introducing Flows!
  • 30 built-in blocks and 30 ready-to-run starter flows, free out of the box
  • Step-by-step results viewer with streaming output
  • Apple Intelligence free on-device; Ollama and cloud AI with Pro
  • Per-flow shortcuts and run flows on Finder files

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.1.0

Meet Flows — turn your clipboard into a one-keystroke automation tool.

  • Flows run multi-step actions on anything you copy — clean it, convert it, summarize it, or transform it, all without leaving the keyboard.
  • 30 built-in blocks across text, URLs, images, and AI, plus 30 starter flows that work the moment you install — free.
  • Live results viewer streams each step as it runs, so you see exactly what happened and can grab the output at any stage.
  • Your AI, your choice — Apple Intelligence runs free and on-device; bring Ollama or cloud models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) with Pro.
  • A shortcut for every flow — trigger any flow with its own global hotkey, or run one straight on files selected in Finder.
  • Plus a faster, searchable block picker and fixes for snippet auto-expansion, onboarding permissions, and image resizing.

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.8

  • - Fixed snippet export so “Export All” works correctly and saves as JSON.
  • - Fixed the menu item count so it respects your configured history limit.
  • - Improved snippet expansion: keywords now respect word boundaries by default, so "do" won’t expand inside words like "redo".
  • - Added a new Snippets setting, “Expand at end of words”, for users who prefer the previous suffix-matching behavior.

item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.7

  • Bug fixes and improvements

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.6

  • Auto-update reliability fix. Show version in menu bar.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.5

  • New settings option -> Side panel previews for expanded clipboard items and snippets
  • Added snippet import and export support, including NanoClip JSON, Alfred, and Raycast formats
  • Bug fixes and improvements
  • Free mode now previews the full current clipboard history, with locked items greyed out and the top 5 still interactive
  • Smoothed expand and collapse window animations

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.4

  • Bug fixes and improvements

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.3

  • Bug fixes and improvements
  • - Fixed the picker visuals for transparent themes by removing the bad square outer stroke/shadow effect and improving the shortcuts companion panel background behavior.
  • - Clipboard items now move back to the top after paste, so the most recently pasted item becomes the first item in history again.
  • - Added a new free Clean theme with solid light/dark backgrounds for better readability.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.2

  • Bug fixes and improvements
  • - Polished DMG installer with drag-to-Applications layout
  • - Fixed Cmd+H obfuscation not updating the list in real time
  • - Fixed Cmd+Enter not copying snippet to clipboard in argument form
  • - Fixed selection highlight getting lost when navigating with arrow keys
  • - Fixed pinned items appearing under time group headers (Today, Yesterday, etc.)
  • - Fixed unpinned items appearing in wrong time group order
  • - App Store build now allows redeeming Polar.sh license keys

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.1

  • NanoClip is a fast, lightweight clipboard manager that lives in your menu bar. Press Cmd+Option+V to instantly access everything you've ever copied — text, images, links, files, code, and colors.
  • CLIPBOARD HISTORY
  • Every copy is saved automatically. Search through your history instantly by typing, scroll back through time-grouped entries, and paste anything with a keystroke. Pin important items so they're always at the top.
  • SMART SNIPPETS
  • Save reusable text templates with dynamic placeholders. Create a snippet, assign a keyword like //sig, and type it in any app — it expands instantly. Snippets support custom arguments that you fill in before pasting.
  • EDIT IN PLACE
  • Press Cmd+E to edit any clipboard item inline. Fix a typo, tweak a URL, update a value — then paste the modified version. Your edits are saved to history.
  • SEQUENTIAL PASTE
  • Queue up multiple items and paste them one by one in order. Perfect for filling out forms, transferring data between apps, or batch-pasting a list of values.
  • RICH LINK PREVIEWS
  • Copied URLs automatically show titles, favicons, and preview images. Even works with bot-protected sites.
  • PERSONAL STATS
  • Track your clipboard habits with daily streaks, busiest hours, top apps, and content type breakdowns. See how you use your clipboard — visualized.
  • 19 THEMES & 14 FONTS
  • Choose from Catppuccin, Nord, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Cyberpunk, Synthwave '84, Liquid Glass, and more. Pick your favorite font — Inter, JetBrains Mono, Sora, and 11 others.
  • iCLOUD SYNC
  • Your clipboard history and snippets sync across all your Macs via iCloud. No accounts, no servers, no setup.
  • PRIVACY FIRST
  • Content obfuscation hides sensitive items like passwords and API keys. All data stays on your device (or your iCloud). We never see your clipboard.
  • KEYBOARD-FIRST DESIGN
  • Navigate, search, expand, edit, pin, queue, and paste — all without touching your mouse. Every action has a keyboard shortcut.
